description: Models under test, as configuration (SCOPE-R9-model-config). One group per arm plus the judge: provider and FULL model id. Every group is Anthropic-backed and shares the same full id by default. Override with PARITY_MODEL (all groups) or PARITY_MODEL_A / PARITY_MODEL_B / PARITY_MODEL_C / PARITY_JUDGE_MODEL (one group); point PARITY_EXPERIMENT_FILE at another file of this shape. Precedence: per-group env > PARITY_MODEL > this file. Full ids only: no aliases (haiku, sonnet), no opus.
